notes.title: Poker Game DLC Update
notes.content:
We are happy to report the main outline of the poker game DLC has been worked out and main scripting will begin soon, in addition we can confirm the DLC will be set after the game ends on the 'harem' route.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/22231741/b9d0d1a5e62893694b2e885669c3b4a9ba4672f0.jpg

Artwork is also getting closer to completion now and will include hundreds of variations and options within the game accounting for many different potential strip possibilities within the game.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/22231741/cffeecd7302cf76f410c97f8cfdd7629e886d896.jpg

Set release date coming soon.

notes.title: Deluxe Edition
notes.content:
Army Gals will now be releasing with a Deluxe Edition which will include all bonus DLC Packs as well as future released DLC story packs.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/22231741/04766346d8235e8dcc06dec898a03f031e6b4596.jpg

The five DLC packs when purchased as part of the Deluxe edition will grant players an additional discount on the full content offered.

At launch the Deluxe Edition will include:

    Army Gals Main Game Content
    DLC #1 - Wallpapers Pack
    DLC #2 - Original Soundtrack
    DLC #3 - Digital Dakimakuras #1
    DLC #4 - Digital Dakimakuras #2
    DLC #5 - The Poker Game

At present this is the total items that are guaranteed as part of the deluxe edition on release, however if release goes well we hope to create more dlc stories for the game in the future, which will also be added to the Deluxe edition.
